purpose: Define domain-specific acquisition requirements without selecting or acquiring a provider.
design_principles: formation, event timing, persistence, removal/reworking, and spatial occurrence are separate authorities
event/interval evidence may constrain HRAB without categorical 280-point interpolation
native provider resolution and uncertainty must be preserved
0 ka is an endpoint constraint, never a paleo initializer
ideal_provider_families: event-dated regional specialist authorities for branches not globally covered
